GW_EXCHANGE.target: Published prescribed-head bottom-outward interval exchange and its interval-average flux.
GW_EXCHANGE.temporal_semantics: State transition over an accepted interval.
GW_EXCHANGE.exact_output_identity: E_bottom_out = -E_top_native - (S_end-S_start) plus explicitly represented source/sink/root terms.
GW_EXCHANGE.vertical_representation_role: Vertical state is required only insofar as it predicts the storage transition under forcing; local terminal boundary shape is not an independent output closure for this target.

GW_LOCAL_DARCY.target: A separately defined terminal local Darcy-face diagnostic at the lower boundary.
GW_LOCAL_DARCY.temporal_semantics: Terminal/local operator diagnostic, not the currently published prescribed-head interval exchange.
candidate_information: conductivity time-level/operator state, including lagged-state semantics when SWKIMPL=0
GW_LOCAL_DARCY.vertical_representation_role: Boundary-adjacent hydraulic shape and operator memory may be relevant.
GW_LOCAL_DARCY.authority_status: NOT_YET_ESTABLISHED_AS_ROM_PURPOSE_OUTPUT; REQUIRES SEPARATE DIAGNOSTIC CONTRACT BEFORE TESTING

superseded_ambiguity: The former broad GW_LB label mixed an interval mass-balance exchange observable with a local terminal hydraulic-flux interpretation. Existing P2-P4 evidence remains valid for its recorded metrics, but future work must name the target as GW_EXCHANGE or GW_LOCAL_DARCY.
